stories.title: Dart's injury hinders Giants as Stafford, Rams pick up MNF win
stories.summary: L.A. exceeded expectations after its Week 1 loss, while New York saw injuries to its stars and couldn't keep up with Matthew Stafford & Co.

stories.title: Sources: Giants QB Dart believed to have sprained MCL; more tests to come
stories.summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is believed to have sustained a sprained MCL on Monday night based on initial exams, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo. He will undergo an MRI on Tuesday.

stories.title: Donald's return fires up Rams, who bounce back with rout of Giants
stories.summary: Aaron Donald -- and the SoFi Stadium crowd's response to him -- sparked the Rams in his first game since the end of the 2023 season.

stories.title: Stafford passes Rivers for sixth all time in passing TDs
stories.summary: Rams QB Matthew Stafford moved to sixth all time in passing touchdowns after throwing his 426th to Davante Adams on Monday night.

stories.title: Sources: Colts' Pierce out weeks; Slayton to join for WR depth
stories.summary: Colts WR Alec Pierce is expected to miss several weeks because of a heel injury but will attempt to avoid surgery in the hopes of returning midseason.
